summary: The registrant, Ares Core Infrastructure Fund, filed an 8-K disclosing the creation of a direct financial obligation after acquiring subsidiaries that are party to a $1.09B senior secured term loan B facility (Rover Credit Agreement). The event is a routine financing transaction linked to a portfolio company investment, noting terms including SOFR+2.25% interest, quarterly repayments of 0.25%, and maturity in October 2031. No change-of-control, premium, or extraordinary corporate event is detailed, so this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
